notes: 159 unchanged originals from a fresh Chromium/WebGL2 viewer session; controls and rotation were verified. Main comparisons contain 81 matched front/side/back pairs at 0/50/100% maturity plus 27 Minecraft left views, with nine mature above-view pairs in a separate sheet.
